description: Structured provenance manifest for advisory catalog records (R06). Each entry pins the exact retrieved bytes frozen alongside this file. Hashes are of raw bytes as retrieved; no normalized representation substitutes the raw hash. versionsec scan never fetches these; verification is offline against the frozen copies.

entries.limitations: GitHub advisory API bodies carry review timestamps and may be edited upstream; the frozen bytes define the checked hash.
